name: Wendy's Jr. Hamburger (Plain on White Bun)
whyItWorks: Wendy's uses 100% fresh, never-frozen North American beef grilled without added marinades or fillers. Served plain on a soft white sandwich bun, it provides easy animal protein with zero dairy, onions, or spices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at the drive-thru: "Jr. Hamburger, totally PLAIN—meat and bun only. No pickles, no onions, no ketchup, no mustard."
